scenes.headline: How Kimi K3 mixes tokens, layers and experts
scenes.sub: Delta-rule memory, latent attention, attention over depth, 16 of 896 experts
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Saltine! Kimi K3 moves information along the sequence, across depth, and across experts.

scenes.text: Three layers in four keep a fixed-size memory updated by a gated delta rule; every fourth attends in full; and each layer reads earlier layers by attention.
scenes.say: Three layers in four keep a fixed memory. Every fourth attends in full. And each layer reads the earlier ones by attention.

scenes.title: Kimi Delta Attention
scenes.text: S_t = (I - β k k^T) Diag(α) S_t-1 + β k v^T
scenes.say: Each head keeps a matrix memory.

parts.note: forget: a decay for every channel
parts.say: First, every channel decays at its own rate.

parts.note: erase what the memory held for this key
parts.say: Then it erases what it held for this key.

parts.note: write the new value: only the error changes
parts.say: And writes the new value. Only the error gets written.

steps.note: KDA state: 96 heads of 128 x 128, fixed at any length
steps.say: Three KDA layers, then one latent attention layer, twenty-three times, and a final global layer.

steps.note: 576 numbers per token per layer, and no positions
steps.say: Only the twenty-four attention layers grow a cache: one small latent per token, with no position encoding.
A plain residual adds every layer with weight one. K3 sums its layers in blocks of twelve.

steps.note: keys are normalised, so size can't win the softmax
steps.say: Each layer has a learned query. It attends over the embedding and every earlier block.

steps.note: about 25% better training efficiency for under 2% cost, reported
steps.say: The softmax weights decide which depths it reads, token by token.
A sigmoid router scores every expert, with a bias from quantile balancing to even the load.
The token is projected down to half width, and only the top sixteen experts run there.
Their mix is normalised and projected back up, and two shared experts add a full-width path.

scenes.label: of attention cache per token, while the KDA state stays fixed
scenes.note: 24 layers x 576 numbers at 16 bits; 27 GiB at 1M tokens
scenes.say: Twenty-seven kilobytes of cache per token, plus the fixed state. A million tokens fit in twenty-seven gigabytes.

scenes.text: K3 spends a fixed memory on most layers, exact attention on a quarter, and learned reads across depth.
scenes.say: A fixed memory on most layers, exact attention on a quarter, and learned reads across depth.

recap: KDA: a gated delta rule per channel
Gated MLA every fourth layer, no positions
scenes.say: A delta rule for memory. Latent attention for recall. Attention across depth, and sixteen experts per token.
